status: Staged administrator issuance and private registration entry locally qualified; not deployed or activated; 1.90 incomplete
scope: Authenticated, current-role/session checked invitation issuance with explicit exact-identity/UTC-expiry review. Audit storage precedes private proof response; authority rechecked afterward. Duplicate/unknown JSON keys rejected; bounded payload and mandatory per-client rate policy. No account creation or email. Audit contains target/expiry/admission, not proof, key, password or email. Private client proof is masked, copied only explicitly, not stored or added to URLs, and cleared on edit/cancel/closure/disconnect/role loss. Uncertain requests are not automatically resent. Invitation input appears inside optional account help and is sent only for registration; registration/login success clears it. Login and all public access remain unchanged.

Includes actual main boot mock-socket register/login payloads and private result routing without public chat.

Covers missing audit, late authority/session loss, unavailable configuration, closed payload schema and audit-write failure without returning a proof. Fake repositories here, not actual Mongo durability or capacity evidence.

Review, masked proof, accessible controls, no horizontal overflow and clearing on collapse qualify. Narrow screenshot independently inspected. Not physical-phone, real-account or Firefox gameplay evidence.
qualification.static: Scoped ESLint, gofmt and git diff whitespace checks pass. Dependencies unchanged; no repeated world/raid/campaign run.
